description: TOTSEE crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C72 H40 Cl8 Dy3 N9 O11,C1 H2 Cl2,2(C6 H14). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 4 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 4 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.486-3.490 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 95.07-97.38°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C72H40Cl8Dy3N9O11·CH2Cl2·2(C6H14).
